project-continuity-modules.role: Execution continuity: tasks, checkpoints, immutable push receipts, required PR gates.

content-generation-modules.role: Narrative and styling authority: writing routing, human-sounding writing, output naming, visual direction, image generation.

agent-custom-setup.role: Install surface: hot-load FULL PCM + FULL CGM + OIO plus the coordination runtime.

observational-issue-ops.role: Issue-log ticketing system: the canonical issue form, the filer stamp, and its triage.

adoption_rule: An adopter pins exactly one release train in its own stack-manifest.json and references each component by the version here. It does not hand-copy individual pins into several files.
note: This is a proposal, not a mandate. The versions above are the ones the sibling issues certified; no adopter has been migrated to consume this train yet.
